title: 'Stop using threats': China takes veiled shot at US over Cuba & Iran in UN speech
content: Chinese Vice President Han Zheng called on the US to respect the sovereignty of Iran and Cuba during his speech. He criticized American actions in the Middle East and urged for an end to the pressure on Cuba. Zheng highlighted the importance of international cooperation among all nations regarding global affairs. His remarks sought to position China as a defender of developing nations.

title: Gauhati University student found dead at homestay; boyfriend detained
content: The lifeless body of 21-year-old Nimisha Thakuria, a Sociology student at Gauhati University, was discovered at a homestay in Garal-Dharapur. Just before her phone was switched off, she called her mother to express fears of an assault. This incident has sparked protests, with demonstrators raising concerns regarding 'love jihad'. Authorities have named Ashiq Ali as a suspect, who claims she took her own life.

title: Florida used robot rabbits to hunt Burmese pythons threatening the Everglades
content: Florida is testing solar-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons in the Everglades. Developed by the South Florida Water Management District and University of Florida, the robotic decoys mimic prey using heat and scent while AI cameras detect approaching snakes. Officials can then alert trained removal agents, adding technology to Florida’s wider python control efforts.

title: After 'big talk' with Xi on 'Super Intelligence', Trump shuts door on joint AI push
content: Donald Trump and Xi Jinping recently convened to explore the concept of super intelligence, albeit ruling out collaborative AI efforts. Trump asserted that the US is at the forefront of AI development, striving to sustain its competitive edge. They both recognized the significance of the term super intelligence in discussions of emerging technologies and initiated a bilateral communication line for super intelligence-related incidents, planning their next conversation for November 2026.

title: Heineken's 50,000 bottle-bricks in 1963 built a house in 1965, then hit a wall
content: In 1963, Heineken produced 50,000 rectangular beer bottles designed to work as building bricks after use. The WOBO bottles were created to address bottle waste and a shortage of building materials, but production costs, design challenges and customer preference for traditional bottles stopped the idea from reaching the market.

title: 'No answer for Gen Z voters': Cong attacks EC's press note, seeks SIR pause
content: Congress has responded to the Election Commission regarding its recent press note and the Special Intensive Revision process. Jairam Ramesh raised several points questioning the credibility and intent of the Election Commission. Allegations of targeting Gen Z voters and the deletion of names from electoral rolls remain unaddressed. The party is calling for immediate suspension of the revision process and accountability for the Chief Election Commissioner.

title: 'Khali pet gold jita hai': Why India's kabaddi team did not eat before final
content: With 10 minutes left, India moved five points ahead after Arjun got past Iran captain Fazel Atrachali and helped India inflict an All-Out. Sumit then made an important tackle on Amirmohammad Zafar Danesh, while Rahul Sethpal also made a key defensive contribution late in the match. The win completed India's unbeaten campaign and gave them their ninth Asian Games gold medal in men's kabaddi.

title: Florida couple sues IVF clinic after baby's blood type reveals wrong sperm used
content: A Florida couple is suing Jacksonville’s Brown Fertility Clinic, alleging the wrong sperm was used during their IVF treatment. Their baby’s unexpected blood type prompted further testing, which the couple says revealed the husband was not the child’s biological father. The lawsuit seeks answers over the alleged fertility clinic mix-up and its lasting emotional impact.

title: Girl started lemonade stand with $10 goal; 7 summers later, sisters raised $55,000
content: Grace Hendrian and her sister June initiated their Lemon-Aid Stand for Good in 2019 to support charity. They aimed to raise $10 but ultimately collected $55,000 for The Salvation Army. Their project encouraged community participation, leading to 14 stands operating by 2026. The sisters received recognition for their volunteer efforts as they also contributed to local families in need. Their fundraising initiative concluded in 2026, marking its final season.

title: US immigration authority has a 10-day deadline on home address
content: USCIS has issued a reminder for immigrants to report changes of address within 10 days of moving. Failing to do so may result in missed notices and delays in immigration cases. Changing addresses with the USPS does not automatically update records with USCIS. Immigrants are encouraged to use the online self-service change-of-address tool for a timely update. Paper forms can be submitted, but online updates are recommended for efficiency.

title: Manager with Rs 85 lakh package reveals how much he actually gets each month
content: Sidharth Maheshwari's insights shed light on the often misleading nature of CTC figures in the job market. For instance, an attractive salary of ₹85 lakh includes various elements such as fixed pay, bonuses, and variable compensation. However, after mandatory deductions like taxes and other non-cash perks, the actual take-home can drop considerably. Therefore, job seekers must be aware of these salary intricacies to ensure they make financially sound choices.

title: Woman lawyer from Assam assaulted in Delhi's Prasad Nagar
content: A lawyer from Assam was reportedly attacked in Delhi amid a property dispute on Friday. Eyewitness accounts reveal that police were on-site as the confrontation unfolded, with a distressing video capturing her distress. The attackers expressed concerns about her being in Delhi due to the ongoing legal matter. In response, both parties have lodged mutual complaints, prompting several FIRs as police delve deeper into this assault and property dispute.

title: Bengaluru man strangled wife, spent 3 days with body before dumping it
content: Sagar Chandra Ravath allegedly killed his wife Anusuya Behra during an argument and concealed her body. He wrapped the body in a bed and left it in their house for three days. After a cleanliness drive unearthed skeletal remains, police began investigating the case. Investigators were able to identify the victim through a clothing tag and a Ganesha pendant.

title: Asian Games Medal Tally: How two kabaddi golds helped India break back into top 10
content: India climbed back into the top 10 of the Asian Games medal tally after a successful Saturday. The country secured a total of seven medals, including two golds in kabaddi competitions. Sawan Barwal earned a historic silver in the marathon, while Prachi Choudhary took bronze in the women's 400m event. Additionally, Tilottama Sen and teammates won silver in shooting, contributing to India's overall count.

title: Brittany Mahomes earns major recognition as KC Current’s $375M rise continues #20
content: Earlier this year, the Kansas City Current launched a free youth soccer league in the Northeast neighbourhood, aiming to give 120 children aged 8 to 10 access to the sport. Co-owner Brittany Mahomes supported the initiative. She also received United WE’s inaugural Champion for Change Award, recognising her leadership in women’s sports and community development, alongside the Mahomes family's philanthropic efforts through the 15 and the Mahomies Foundation.

title: Chiefs heiress Gracie Hunt opens up on faith and life away from Kansas City
content: Gracie Hunt, the Kansas City Chiefs’ billionaire heiress, opens up about her life when she is not busy during the season.

title: When the referee fumbles: Election Commission row explained in 7 key questions
content: Election Commissioners are voicing apprehensions about internal decision-making and communication challenges within the Election Commission. Tensions have emerged surrounding form modifications and voter database access. This situation fuels a critical debate on the authority of the Chief Election Commissioner in relation to other commissioners. Additionally, existing legislation regarding appointments and the independence of the Commission is under examination.

title: Asian Games: Prachi Choudhary wins 400m bronze as India’s medal tally swells to 30
content: India's performance at the Asian Games improved as Prachi Choudhary won a bronze medal in women’s 400m. This victory raised India's total medal count to 30, comprising four gold, 12 silver, and 14 bronze. Tajinderpal Singh Toor secured a silver in the men’s shot put after a strong competition. Meanwhile, two athletes advanced to the women’s 200m final, showing promise for further medal opportunities.

title: EC-SIR row brings oppn on same page; INDIA bloc to hold meeting on Sept 30
content: In New Delhi on September 30, the INDIA bloc's opposition parties are set to meet, focusing on critical electoral matters. The discussions will center on how to collectively address changes to the electoral rolls mandated by the Election Commission. Prominent entities like the Congress and Trinamool Congress have raised alarms over Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's strategies.

title: Rumours of ghosts, 'missing' girls spark violent protest at Chitkara University
content: Protests erupted at Chitkara University following unverified rumors that two female students were missing. Police received reports of vandalism involving damaged vehicles and a confrontation with students. University officials clarified that no girls were missing and urged students to disregard the rumors. An investigation is underway to locate the source of the misinformation and to ensure campus safety.

title: Housing sales slipped 6% in top Indian cities during Jul-Sep quarter: Report
content: In the July-September quarter, residential property sales in nine key Indian cities dipped by six percent, totaling just 1.03 lakh units, a stark contrast to last year's figures. This decline signifies lower demand alongside a decrease in new housing supply. While Bengaluru and Hyderabad saw slight growth in sales, many other cities faced significant drops, reflecting a broader slump in the residential real estate market amidst prevailing economic challenges.

title: Asian Games: Tajinderpal Singh misses hat-trick of golds, wins silver in shot put
content: Tajinderpal Singh Toor fell short in his quest for a third consecutive gold at the Asian Games, securing a silver medal instead. His top mark of 20.64 meters couldn't eclipse Iran's Mohammadreza Tayebise, who made history with a new Games record. Yet, India's medal count swells as sprinters Harita Bhadra and Unnathi Bolland both excel in reaching the women's 200m final alongside Nandhini Kongan in the 100m hurdles.

title: Kotak says it’s not ‘unfair’ to Jaiswal, tells him to ‘keep working hard and waiting’
content: Sitanshu Kotak highlighted the importance of hard work for Yashasvi Jaiswal, particularly in the limited scope of ODI matches available to him. He clarified that Jaiswal's omission from the England tour should not be interpreted as unjust. Kotak praised the support provided by seasoned players to nurture young talents like Jaiswal.

title: Influencer flaunts gold, cash on Instagram; burglars make off with booty
content: After showcasing their opulent lifestyle on social media, businessman Vinoth Kumar and his influencer partner Madhumitha suffered a robbery, resulting in a loss of about Rs 1 crore in valuables. Police suspect the burglars used social media to pinpoint when the couple was away from home. Investigators are scrutinizing Madhumitha’s online content related to their shopping trips. To apprehend the thieves, five police teams have been deployed.

title: India’s kabaddi double! Men beat Iran to defend gold after women’s triumph at Asian Games
content: At the Asian Games 2026, India celebrated a remarkable achievement with a golden double in kabaddi, clinching victories in both finals. The men's team edged past Iran with a score of 40-34 in a thrilling match, while the women's team secured their win at 37-34. These triumphs not only defended their previous titles but also bolstered India's impressive overall medal tally to 28, securing a position in the top 10.

title: ‘Stop acting as EC's spokespersons': Priyank Kharge slams BJP amid SIR row
content: Priyank Kharge has voiced serious concerns about the BJP's support for the Election Commission's recent decisions. He insists that the Commission must clarify its electoral-roll processes to maintain credibility. This critique underscores significant implications for India's democratic framework. Former election commissioner Om Prakash Rawat has also weighed in on the Commission's decision-making.

title: Masked men try to abduct woman in Dehradun; police form teams to nab them
content: Early in the morning, at 6:45 AM on Sahastradhara Road in Dehradun, an attempted abduction occurred involving two men in a black hatchback. As a woman was returning home after dropping her daughter at college, she became a target. Fortunately, local witnesses, including sanitation workers, stepped in to assist and notified authorities.

title: Diana after Diana: How her story kept changing long after her death
content: Diana Frances Spencer, known as Princess Diana, remains a significant figure even after her tragic death. Various individuals and institutions construct different portrayals of her character and life experiences. Her brother Charles Spencer recently published a memoir that reflects on her legacy and relationships. Diana's influence persists, shaping identities and resonating in communities around the world.

title: Iran denies link to Houthi attacks; warns US as Trump rejects peace offer
content: In a recent interview, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian firmly dismissed claims of Iran's involvement in the Houthi-Saudi conflict, highlighting the critical role of diplomacy in easing regional tensions. He condemned US and Israeli actions that exacerbate hostilities among Gulf nations and voiced scepticism regarding negotiations with Washington, referencing historical grievances. Iran's military also issued a stark warning regarding potential threats to US interests.

title: 'Floods don’t travel with visas’: Nepal PM asks India, China to join warning network
content: In his maiden address to UN General Assembly, Shah, 36, said, “Glaciers and floods do not travel with a visa stamped on passports.” His address on Thursday came during his first foreign trip since taking office on March 27.

title: Iraq loses $60 billion to Iran war as Hormuz squeeze hits oil exports
content: Iraq is facing significant economic difficulties as its oil exports are disrupted by the ongoing Iran war, resulting in serious fuel shortages. With over 90 percent of its federal budget reliant on oil revenues, Prime Minister reports a staggering $60 billion loss in oil income. Even as a key crude oil producer, Iraq still finds itself importing gasoline.

title: ‘No one will marry her’: Baranica defies taunts to make pole vault history at Asiad
content: Baranica Elangovan's remarkable achievement at the Asian Games saw her clinch the bronze medal in pole vault, defying numerous hurdles and injuries along the way. After undergoing ACL surgery in 2019 and shifting her focus from long jump to pole vault, her success stands as a historic milestone for India. With heartfelt gratitude towards her parents and coach, Elangovan hopes to inspire the next generation of Indian pole vaulters.

title: Watch: Stone pelting shatters Duronto window as passengers sit just inches away
content: A stone was thrown at the Duronto Express after it passed Borkhedi station in Maharashtra. Window glasses in coaches A-1, B-2, and B-5 were shattered due to the incident. Railway Protection Force and Government Railway Police conducted a thorough search in the surrounding areas. No evidence or suspicious persons were found after the investigation. A case was registered against an unknown person under the Railway Act.

content: The 800-metre-long Nerekadavu-Makkekadavu bridge across Vembanad Lake connects Udayanapuram grama panchayat in Kottayam with Thaikkattussery panchayat in Alappuzha. title: Why is Russia sending dead princes, saints into Ukraine battle?
content: relics of medieval Russian rulers and warrior saints are being taken to military bases and units at the front . in early September, a fragment of the remains of the prince was sent to Russian troops and is now being moved around military bases in eastern Ukraine . the move is part of a broader role the Russian Orthodox Church has played during the war .

content: the election commission said all decisions taken on the special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls were approved unanimously . the clarification comes amid row over report that claimed differences within the EC over SIR of electoral roll .

title: At least 12 dead in suicide bomb blast near police post in northwestern Pakistan
content: a suicide bomber detonated an explosives-laden vehicle at a roadside police checkpoint in northwestern Pakistan . at least 12 people were killed and around 35 others wounded, police said . the attack took place in dera Ismail Khan, a district in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province .

title: Beauty and the beast: China brought its own wheels, a red flag, to Washington
content: china's Hongqi N701, the heavily armoured state limousine used by Xi Jinping during his state visit to Washington . the limousine is an 18-foot rolling declaration that the country now has a beauty of its own to match America's "Beast" the symbolism was hard to miss .

title: As Trump hugs Xi and plugs Sharif, India feels the squeeze
